items.title: Norris Turney interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: But Duke didn’t pay into the pension fund so I got no pension from him, or Ray Charles. No band leaders pay into the pension fund.

ctx.x: But Duke didn’t pay into the pension fund so I got no pension from him, or Ray Charles. No band leaders pay into the pension fund. But when you get on Broadway, they have to pay into it.

Right. It’s a little more regulated. I sometimes wonder about musicians like Harry Carney and so forth, who spent all those years on that band, if he had wanted to retire, could he have just stopped playing? Unless he had saved up.
